text: This FAQ goes on your text alerts page and answers the question the overview cites simpletexting.com for.
draft:
How do I alert my crew by text without a developer?
TextBolt turns the emails your tools already send into text alerts. Forward an alert address, pick who gets the text, and your crew hears about it within [a minute]. There is no code to write and nothing to install on the phones. You can start on the [free plan] and add numbers as the crew grows.
